pli-tv-kd22:1.1.1: Tena kho pana samayena vassasataparinibbute bhagavati Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū Vesāliyaṃ dasa vatthūni dīpenti:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.2: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo, kappati dvaṅgulakappo, k. gāmantarakappo, k. āvāsakappo, k. anumatikappo, k. āciṇṇakappo, k. amathitakappo, k. jalogi pātuṃ, k. adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ, k. jātarūparajatan ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto Vajjīsu cārikaṃ caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.4: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.5: tena kho pana samayena Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū tadah' uposathe kaṃsapātiṃ udakena pūretvā majjhe bhikkhusaṃghassa ṭhapetvā āgate Vesālike upāsake evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.6: dethāvuso saṃghassa kahāpaṇam pi aḍḍham pi pādam pi māsakarūpam pi,
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.8: evaṃ vutte āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto Vesālike upāsake etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.9: māvuso adattha saṃghassa kahāpaṇam pi . . . māsakarūpam pi,
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.14: evam pi kho Vesālikā upāsakā āyasmatā Yasena Kākaṇḍakaputtena vuccamānā adaṃsu yeva saṃghassa kahāpaṇam pi . . . māsakarūpam pi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.15: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena taṃ hiraññaṃ bhikkhaggena paṭivisaṃ ṭhapetvā bhājesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.16: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Yasaṃ Kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.17: eso te āvuso Yasa hiraññassa paṭiviso 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.18: n' atthi me āvuso hiraññassa paṭiviso, nāhaṃ hiraññaṃ sādiyāmīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.2: ayaṃ āvuso Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosati paribhāsati appasādaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.3: hand' assa mayaṃ paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ karomā 'ti. te tassa paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.4: atha kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto Vesālike Vajjiputtake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.7: detha me āvuso anudūtaṃ bhikkhun ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.8: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ sammannitvā āyasmato Yasassa Kākaṇḍakaputtassa anudūtaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.9: atha kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ Vesāliṃ pavisitvā Vesālike upāsake etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.10: ahaṃ kirāyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi paribhāsāmi appasādaṃ karomi
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.11: yo 'haṃ adhammaṃ adhammo 'ti vadāmi, dhammaṃ dhammo 'ti vadāmi, avinayaṃ avinayo 'ti vadāmi, vinayaṃ vinayo 'ti vadāmi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.1: ekam idaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.2: tatra kho āvuso bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.3: cattāro 'me bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.4: katame cattāro. abbhaṃ bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.8: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.9: evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.11: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti merayaṃ pivanti surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.12: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.13: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti methunadhammā appaṭiviratā.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.15: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti jātarūparajatapaṭiggahanā appaṭiviratā.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.17: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.20: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.22: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etad avoca satthā:
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.43: evaṃvādī kirāhaṃ āyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi paribhāsāmi appasādaṃ karomi
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.44: yo 'haṃ adhammaṃ adhammo 'ti vadāmi dhammaṃ dhammo 'ti vadāmi avinayaṃ avinayo 'ti vadāmi vinayaṃ vinayo 'ti vadāmi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.1: ekam idaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.2: tena kho panāvuso samayena rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.6: tena kho panāvuso samayena Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.7: atha kho āvuso Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.13: asakkhi kho āvuso Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.14: atha kho āvuso Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.15: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āvuso Maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.16: idha bhante rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ . . . paṭigaṇhanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.20: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ taṃ bhante parisaṃ etad avocaṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.26: asakkhiṃ kho ahaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.27: kacc' āhaṃ bhante evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī c' eva bhagavato homi na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi dhammassa vā anudhammaṃ vyākaromi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.28: taggha tvaṃ gāmaṇī evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī c' eva hosi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.29: na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi dhammassa vā anudhammaṃ vyākarosi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.30: na hi gāmaṇī kappati samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ,
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.34: yassa kho gāmaṇī jātarūparajataṃ kappati pañca pi tassa kāmaguṇā kappanti,
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.35: yassa pañca kāmaguṇā kappanti ekaṃsena gāmaṇī dhāreyyāsi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.37: api cāhaṃ gāmaṇī evaṃ vadāmi: tiṇaṃ tiṇatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.41: na tv evāhaṃ gāmaṇī kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabban ti vadāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.42: evaṃvādī kirāhaṃ āyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi paribhāsāmi appasādaṃ karomi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.43: yo 'haṃ adhammaṃ adhammo 'ti vadāmi . . . vinayaṃ vinayo 'ti vadāmi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd22:1.5.1: ekam idaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā tatth' eva Rājagahe āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ ārabbha jātarūparajataṃ paṭikkhipi sikkhāpadañ ca paññāpesi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.5.2: evaṃvādī kirāhaṃ āyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi paribhāsāmi appasādaṃ karomi
pli-tv-kd22:1.5.3: yo 'haṃ adhammaṃ adhammo 'ti vadāmi . . . vinayaṃ vinayo 'ti vadāmi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.1: evaṃ vutte Vesālikā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ Yasaṃ Kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.2: eko 'va bhante ayyo Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto samaṇo Sakyaputtiyo,
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.4: vasatu bhante ayyo Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto Vesāliyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.5: mayaṃ ayyassa Yasassa Kākaṇḍakaputtassa ussukkaṃ karissāma cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānan ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.6: atha kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto Vesālike upāsake saññāpetvā anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ārāmaṃ agamāsi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.1: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū anudūtaṃ bhikkhuṃ pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.2: khamāpitā āvuso Yasena Kākaṇḍakaputtena Vesālikā upāsakā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.4: eko 'va Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto samaṇo Sakyaputtiyo kato,
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.7: ayaṃ āvuso Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto amhehi asammato gihīnaṃ pakāsesi,
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.10: atha kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā Kosambiyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.11.1: atha kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto Pāṭheyyakānañ ca Avantidakkhiṇāpathakānañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.16: pure adhammavādino balavanto honti dhammavādino dubbalā honti,
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.17: avinayavādino balavanto honti vinayavādino dubbalā hontīti. ||7||
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī Ahogaṅge pabbate paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.2: atha kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto yena Ahogaṅgo pabbato yenāyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sambhūtaṃ Sāṇavāsiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmantaṃ Sambhūtaṃ Sāṇavāsiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.4: ime bhante Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū Vesāliyaṃ dasa vatthūni dīpenti:
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.6: handa mayaṃ bhante imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyissāma,
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.11: evam āvuso 'ti kho āyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī āyasmato Yasassa Kākaṇḍakaputtassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.13: sabbe āraññakā sabbe piṇḍapātikā sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā sabbeva arahanto
pli-tv-kd22:1.8.16: app ekacce āraññakā app ekacce piṇḍapātikā app ekacce paṃsukūlikā app ekacce tecīvarikā sabbeva arahanto
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.1: atha kho therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mantayamānānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.2: idaṃ kho adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷañ ca vālañ ca.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.3: kathaṃ nu kho mayaṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma yena mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Revato Soreyye paṭivasati
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.5: bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.6: atha kho therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.7: ayaṃ kho āyasmā Revato Soreyye paṭivasati
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.9: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma evaṃ mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.14: idaṃ kho adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷañ ca vālañ ca,
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.15: na kho me taṃ patirūpaṃ yo 'haṃ evarūpe adhikaraṇe osakkeyyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.16: idāni ca pana te bhikkhū āgacchissanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.17: so 'haṃ tehi ākiṇṇo na phāsuṃ gamissāmi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.18: yan nūnāhaṃ paṭigacc' eva gaccheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.19: atha kho āyasmā Revato Soreyyā Saṃkassaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.20: atha kho therā bhikkhū Soreyyaṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.24: atha kho āyasmā Revato Saṃkassā Kaṇṇakujjaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.25: atha kho therā bhikkhū Saṃkassaṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.29: atha kho āyasmā Revato Kaṇṇakujjā Udumbaraṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.30: atha kho therā bhikkhū Kaṇṇakujjaṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.34: atha kho āyasmā Revato Udumbarā Aggaḷapuraṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.35: atha kho therā bhikkhū Udumbaraṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.39: atha kho āyasmā Revato Aggaḷapurā Sahajātiṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.40: atha kho therā bhikkhū Aggaḷapuraṃ gantvā pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.44: atha kho therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ Sahajātiyā sambhāvesuṃ. ||9||
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.1: atha kho āyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī āyasmantaṃ Yasaṃ Kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.2: ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā Revato bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.3: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ pañhaṃ pucchissāma paṭibalo āyasmā Revato eken' eva pañhena sakalam pi rattiṃ vītināmetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.4: idāni ca panāyasmā Revato antevāsikaṃ sarabhāṇakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ajjhesissati,
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.5: so tvaṃ tassa bhikkhuno sarabhaññapariyosāne āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ upasaṃkamitvā imāni dasa vatthūni puccheyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.6: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmato Sambhūtassa Sāṇavāsissa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.7: atha kho āyasmā Revato antevāsikaṃ sarabhāṇakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ajjhesi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.8: atha kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto tassa bhikkhuno sarabhaññapariyosāne yenāyasmā Revato ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.9: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Yaso Kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.17: kappati bhante dvaṅgulāya chāyāya vītivattāya vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjitun ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.21: kappati bhante idāni gāmantaraṃ gamissāmīti bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjitun ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.25: kappati bhante sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā nānuposathaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.29: kappati bhante vaggena saṃghena kammaṃ kātuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.34: kappati bhante idaṃ me upajjhāyena ajjhāciṇṇaṃ idaṃ me ācariyena ajjhāciṇṇaṃ taṃ ajjhācaritun ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.35: āciṇṇakappo kho āvuso ekacco kappati ekacco na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.38: kappati bhante yan taṃ khīraṃ khīrabhāvaṃ vijahitaṃ asampattaṃ dadhibhāvaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ pātun ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.42: kappati bhante yā sā surā asurātā asampattā majjabhāvaṃ sā pātun ti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.48: ime bhante Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū Vesāliyaṃ imāni dasa vatthūni dīpenti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.49: handa mayaṃ bhante imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyissāma,
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.54: evaṃ āvuso 'ti kho āyasmā Revato āyasmato Yasassa Kākaṇḍakaputtassa paccassosi. ||10||1||
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.2: Yaso kira Kākaṇḍakaputto imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitukāmo pakkhaṃ pariyesati labhati ca kira pakkhan ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.3: atha kho Vesālikānaṃ Vajjiputtakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.4: idaṃ kho adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷañ ca vālañ ca.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.5: kan nu kho mayaṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma yena mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.6: atha kho Vesālikānaṃ Vajjiputtakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.7: ayaṃ kho āyasmā Revato bahussuto āgatāgamo . . . sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.8: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma evaṃ mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.9: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū pahūtaṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ paṭiyādesuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.10: pattam pi cīvaram pi nisīdanam pi sucigharam pi kāyabandhanam pi parissāvanam pi dhammakarakam pi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.11: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū taṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ ādāya nāvāya Sahajātiṃ ujjaviṃsu,
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.12: nāvāya paccorohitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle bhattavissaggaṃ karonti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.1: atha kho āyasmato Sāḷhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.4: atha kho āyasmato Sāḷhassa dhammañ ca vinayañ ca paccavekkhantassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.5: adhammavādino Pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.6: atha kho aññatarā suddhāvāsakāyikā devatā āyasmato Sāḷhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.7: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva suddhāvāsesu devesu antarahitā āyasmato Sāḷhassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.8: atha kho sā devatā āyasmantaṃ Sāḷhaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.9: sādhu bhante Sāḷha adhammavādī Pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādī Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū,
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.10: tena hi bhante Sāḷha yathādhammo tathā tiṭṭhāhīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.11: pubbe cāhaṃ devate etarahi ca yathādhammo tathā ṭhito,
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.12: api cāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvikaromi app eva maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.1: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū taṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ ādāya yenāyasmā Revato ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.3: pattam pi cīvaram pi nisīdanam pi sucigharam pi kāyabandhanam pi parissāvanam pi dhammakarakam pīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.4: alaṃ āvuso, paripuṇṇaṃ me ticīvaran ti na icchi paṭiggahetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.5: tena kho pana samayena Uttaro nāma bhikkhu vīsativasso āyasmato Revatassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.6: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū yenāyasmā Uttaro ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Uttaraṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.9: alaṃ āvuso, paripuṇṇaṃ me ticīvaran ti na icchi paṭiggahetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.10: manussā kho āvuso Uttara bhagavato sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ upanāmenti,
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.11: sace bhagavā paṭigaṇhāti ten' eva te attamanā honti,
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.12: no ce bhagavā paṭigaṇhāti āyasmato Ānandassa upanāmenti
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.14: yathā bhagavatā paṭiggahito evam eso bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.16: yathā therena paṭiggahito evam eso bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.17: atha kho āyasmā Uttaro Vesālikehi Vajjiputtakehi bhikkhūhi nippīḷiyamāno ekaṃ cīvaraṃ aggahesi
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.18: vadeyyāthāvuso yen' attho 'ti. ettakaṃ āyasmā Uttaro theraṃ vadetu: ettakaṃ bhante thero saṃghamajjhe vadetu: puratthimesu janapadesu buddhā bhagavanto uppajjanti, dhammavādī Pācīnakā bhikkhū adhammavādī Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū 'ti. evam āvuso 'ti
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.24: kho āyasmā Uttaro Vesālikānam Vajjiputtakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Revato ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.28: adhamme maṃ tvaṃ bhikkhu niyojesīti thero āyasmantaṃ Uttaraṃ paṇāmesi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.29: atha kho Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Uttaraṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.32: adhamme maṃ tvaṃ bhikkhu niyojesīti thero maṃ paṇāmesīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.34: āmāvuso 'ti. api nu ca mayaṃ garunissayaṃ gaṇhāmā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.1: atha kho saṃgho taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchitukāmo sannipati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.2: atha kho āyasmā Revato saṃghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.4: sace mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ idha vūpasameyyāma siyāpi mūlādāyakā bhikkhū punakammāya ukkoṭeyyuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, yatth' ev' imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ samuppannaṃ, saṃgho tatth' ev' imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.6: atha kho therā bhikkhū Vesāliṃ agamaṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.8: tena kho pana samayena Sabbakāmī nāma pathavyā saṃghathero vīsaṃvassasatiko upasampadāya āyasmato Ānandassa saddhivihāriko Vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.9: atha kho āyasmā Revato āyasmantaṃ Sambhūtaṃ Sāṇavāsiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.10: ahaṃ āvuso yasmiṃ vihāre Sabbakāmī thero viharati taṃ vihāraṃ upagacchāmi,
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.11: so tvaṃ kālass' eva āyasmantaṃ Sabbakāmiṃ upasaṃkamitvā imāni dasa vatthūni puccheyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.12: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī āyasmato Revatassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.13: atha kho āyasmā Revato yasmiṃ vihāre Sabbakāmī thero viharati taṃ vihāraṃ upagañchi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.14: gabbhe āyasmato Sabbakāmissa senāsanaṃ paññattaṃ hoti gabbhapamukhe āyasmato Revatassa.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.19: ayaṃ bhikkhu āgantuko kilanto na nipajjatīti
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.1: atha kho āyasmā Sabbakāmī rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.2: katamena tvaṃ bhummi vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharasīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.3: mettāvihārena kho aham bhante etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.4: kullakavihārena kira tvaṃ bhummi etarahi bahulaṃ viharasi,
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.5: kullakavihāro eso bhummi yad idaṃ mettā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.6: pubbe pi me bhante gihibhūtassa āciṇṇā mettā,
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.7: tenāhaṃ etarahi pi mettāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi, api ca mayā cirapattaṃ arahattaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.8: thero pana bhante katamena vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.9: suññatāvihārena kho ahaṃ bhummi etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.10: mahāpurisavihārena kira bhante thero etarahi bahulaṃ viharati,
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.11: mahāpurisavihāro eso bhante yad idaṃ suññatā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.12: pubbe pi me bhummi gihibhūtassa āciṇṇā suññatā,
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.13: tenāhaṃ etarahi pi suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi, api ca mayā cirapattaṃ arahattan ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.1: ayañ carahi therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarākathā vippakatā, athāyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī tasmiṃ anuppatto hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.2: atha kho āyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī yenāyasmā Sabbakāmī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sabbakāmiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sambhūto Sāṇavāsī āyasmantaṃ Sabbakāmiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.4: ime bhante Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā bhikkhū Vesāliyaṃ dasa vatthūni dīpenti:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.6: therena bhante upajjhāyassa mūle bahu dhammo ca vinayo ca pariyatto,
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.7: therassa bhante dhammañ ca vinayañ ca paccavekkhantassa kathaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.10: tayāpi kho āvuso upajjhāyassa mūle bahu dhammo ca vinayo ca pariyatto,
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.11: tuyhaṃ panāvuso dhammañ ca vinayañ ca paccavekkhantassa kathaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.14: mayhaṃ kho bhante dhammañ ca vinayañ ca paccavekkhantassa evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.15: adhammavādī Pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādī Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū 'ti,
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.16: api cāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvikaromi, app eva maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.17: mayham pi kho āvuso dhammañ ca vinayañ ca paccavekkhantassa evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.18: adhammavādī Pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādī Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū 'ti,
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.19: api cāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvikaromi, app eva maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyā 'ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.1: atha kho saṃgho taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchitukāmo sannipati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.2: tasmiṃ kho pana adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni c' eva bhassāni jāyanti na c' ekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.3: atha kho āyasmā Revato saṃghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.5: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni c' eva bhassāni jāyanti na c' ekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.6: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasameyya.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.7: cattāro Pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro Pāṭheyyake bhikkhū uccini:
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.9: āyasmantaṃ ca Sabbakāmiṃ āyasmantaṃ ca Sāḷhaṃ āyasmantaṃ ca Khujjasobhitaṃ āyasmantaṃ ca Vāsabhagāmikaṃ,
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.11: āyasmantaṃ ca Revataṃ āyasmantaṃ ca Sambhūtaṃ Sāṇavāsiṃ āyasmantaṃ ca Yasaṃ Kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ āyasmantaṃ ca Sumanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.12: atha kho āyasmā Revato saṃghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.14: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni c' eva bhassāni jāyanti na c' ekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.15: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho cattāro Pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro Pāṭheyyake bhikkhū sammanneyya ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.19: saṃgho cattāro . . . sammannati ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.20: yassāyasmato khamati catunnaṃ Pācīnakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ catunnaṃ Pāṭheyyakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sammuti ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ, so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.22: sammatā saṃghena cattāro Pācīnakā bhikkhū cattāro Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.24: tena kho pana samayena Ajito nāma bhikkhu dasavasso saṃghassa pātimokkhuddesako hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.25: atha kho saṃgho āyasmantam pi Ajitaṃ sammanni
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.27: atha kho therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.28: kattha nu kho mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.29: atha kho therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.30: ayaṃ kho Vālikārāmo ramaṇīyo appasaddo appanigghoso.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.31: yan nūna mayaṃ Vālikārāme imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.32: atha kho therā bhikkhū Vālikārāmaṃ agamaṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.1: atha kho āyasmā Revato saṃghaṃ ñāpesi:
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.3: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ Sabbakāmiṃ vinayaṃ puccheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.6: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ Revatena vinayaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.7: atha kho āyasmā Revato āyasmantaṃ Sabbakāmiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.19: iti p' idaṃ vatthuṃ uddhammaṃ ubbinayaṃ apagatasatthusāsanaṃ,
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.75: āciṇṇakappo āvuso ekacco kappati ekacco na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.126: iti p' imāni vatthūni uddhammāni ubbinayāni apagatasatthusāsanānīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.127: nihataṃ etaṃ āvuso adhikaraṇaṃ santaṃ vūpasantaṃ suvūpasantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.128: api ca maṃ tvaṃ āvuso saṃghamajjhe pi imāni dasa vatthūni puccheyyāsi tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññattiyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.129: atha kho āyasmā Revato āyasmantaṃ Sabbakāmiṃ saṃghamajjhe pi imāni dasa vatthūni pucchi,
pli-tv-kd22:2.9.1: imāya kho pana vinayasaṃgītiyā satta bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ, tasmāyaṃ vinayasaṃgīti sattasatīti vuccatīti. ||9||2||
pli-tv-kd22:2.9.2: sattasatikakkhandhakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ dvādasamaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthu pañcavīsati.
